title: Hans's tasks (25th Anniversary task list)
series: 25th Anniversary celebrations (task list available until 31 December 2026)
start: Talk to Hans in the Lumbridge Castle courtyard (talk about the anniversary tasks) to receive the 25th Anniversary task list. The tasks can be completed in any order, but you need the task list with you. After completing all of them, speak to Hans again for the reward.

items.t: Full mime outfit (can be bought from Iffie's Random Costume Shop during the task)
Materials for any Summoning pouch (can be bought from Pikkupstix's Summoning Shop during the task):

recommended.t: Stardust with teleport unlocked, or wicked hood

steps.t: Talk to Hans about 25th Anniversary tasks.

sub.t: Wiki task list: year 2001 · content referenced: RuneScape · dialogue NPC: Hans

steps.t: When the “Choose an option:” menu appears, select “Talk about Anniversary tasks.”

sub.t: You need free backpack space to receive the task list (wiki transcript: without space Hans tells you to talk to him again when you have room).
If you ever lose the list, talk to Hans again and select “I lost your task list.” for a replacement (wiki: option only shown without the list).

steps.t: A “25TH ANNIVERSARY TASK” pop-up appears for “Hans Free”.

sub.t: Task complete: “Hans Free” – Talk to Hans about 25th Anniversary tasks.

steps.sec: Task 2 of 25: 2002 – Dragon These Bones With Me
steps.t: Have some dragon bones in your backpack (wiki: items needed for this activity).

steps.sec: Task 2 of 25: 2002 – Dragon These Bones With Me
steps.t: Show Hans some dragon bones.

sub.t: Wiki task list: year 2002 · content referenced: Dragon bones (and Dragon Slayer) · dialogue NPC: Hans

steps.sec: Task 2 of 25: 2002 – Dragon These Bones With Me

steps.t: Talk to an examiner at the Exam Centre.

sub.t: Wiki task list: year 2003 · content referenced: The Dig Site · dialogue NPC: Examiner

Perform the Glass Wall emote while wearing the full mime outfit inside of Thessalia's Fine Clothes in Varrock.

steps.t: Have the materials for any Summoning pouch (they can be bought from Pikkupstix's Summoning Shop during the task):

sub.t: 7 spirit shards
1 gold charm
1 wolf bones
1 pouch

sub.t: If players have no ring of kinship, they can sail there with Bryll Thoksdottir who can be found in the south of the Taverley lodestone.

steps.t: Show Orla Fairweather, south-east of Draynor jail, a Divination memory. This can't be completed in Burthorpe or at the Memorial to Guthix.

sub.t: Wiki task list: year 2021 · content referenced: Divination improvements · dialogue NPC: Orla Fairweather

steps.sec: Task 21 of 25: 2021 – By Guthix, to Orla!

sub.t: Task complete: “By Guthix, to Orla!” – Show Orla Fairweather, south-east of Draynor jail, a Divination memory. This can't be completed in Burthorpe or at the Memorial to Guthix.

sub.t: Wiki task list: year 2022 · content referenced: Het's Oasis · dialogue NPC: Etta Stone

steps.sec: Task 22 of 25: 2022 – It's Not Time to Duel
steps.t: A “25TH ANNIVERSARY TASK” pop-up appears for “It's Not Time to Duel”.

sub.t: Task complete: “It's Not Time to Duel” – Talk to Etta Stone in front of Het's Oasis, north of Al Kharid.

steps.sec: Task 24 of 25: 2024 – Wish Upon a Star
steps.t: Talk to Wizard Rosalina on the 2nd floor [UK] / 3rd floor [US] of the Wizards' Tower.

sub.t: Wiki task list: year 2024 · content referenced: Shooting Star refresh · dialogue NPC: Wizard Rosalina

steps.sec: Task 24 of 25: 2024 – Wish Upon a Star
steps.t: A “25TH ANNIVERSARY TASK” pop-up appears for “Wish Upon a Star”.

sub.t: Task complete: “Wish Upon a Star” – Talk to Wizard Rosalina on the 2nd floor [UK] / 3rd floor [US] of the Wizards' Tower.

steps.t: Attempt to enter the Crafting Guild north of Rimmington.

sub.t: Wiki task list: year 2025 · content referenced: 2025 Crafting update · dialogue NPC: Master Crafter

steps.t: A “25TH ANNIVERSARY TASK” pop-up appears for “Feeling Crafty”.

sub.t: Task complete: “Feeling Crafty” – Attempt to enter the Crafting Guild north of Rimmington.

steps.t: After all 25 tasks are done, talk to Hans in Lumbridge Castle courtyard again and ask about the rewards. You receive the 25th Anniversary cape cosmetic override.
When the “Choose an option:” menu appears, select “Talk about Anniversary tasks.”, then select “Do you have any rewards for me?”

sub.t: The “Do you have any rewards for me?” option only appears after completing the list and before claiming the reward (wiki transcript).

steps.t: Activate the cape via the ‘Wardrobe’ tab in the ‘Customisations’ interface (the game message in the wiki transcript of Hans). Done!
